revised_teaching_units.scope: Follow the R3 readback through a Kubernetes worker stop, failed scheduling with a node-local PV, a restore onto a new claim and the unchanged NodePort.
revised_teaching_units.observation: Linux CI stops the owned worker container. The old claim blocks B. B restores an independent backup to a different PV and PVC, then three consecutive readbacks match R3 and the original attachment.

revised_teaching_units.scope: Connect saved activations on CPU to the observed PyTorch allocated peak and timed steady-state updates on one RTX PRO 6000.
revised_teaching_units.observation: Paired source runs reduce the 4096-token allocated peak from 33.92 to 27.22 GiB and slow throughput. The 2048-token peak instead increases by 1 MiB.

revised_teaching_units.scope: Contrast the public read-only adapter gate with a local Kairo write, forced exit, and two readback-only resumptions.
revised_teaching_units.observation: Four local phases were checked independently. Both resumptions avoid write reentry; only the matching source version confirms the receipt. The public package permits checking the normalized record.
